scripts.title: Gold Block 4uto F4rm
scripts.features:
I saw Deni210(Ruby Hub) uploaded a script for BABFT, but no one saw mine, so I decided to repost this
This script contains 2 farm for BABFT:
- Gold Farm
- Gold Block Farm

The Gold Farm is a standard automated agricultural system designed to generate in-game currency known as gold.
On the other hand, the Gold Block Farm is an unconventional concept that I have not observed being implemented by others. Its purpose is to cultivate gold blocks.

--[[IMPORTANT]]--
To activate the auto gold block farm, please go to [ProBaconHub] tab > Click "Games" > Choose "Build A Boat". A new tab should pop up on the tab bar on the left. Click it, then click on the "Gold block autofarm (Beta)" BUTTON. To disable it, simply click "claim".

--[[PEAK]]--
I have already created a script for Mad City Auto Rob and Mad City Kit.
There are two versions of Mad City Kit: the regular version and one for Solara executor.

-[[UPDATE]]--
All Mad City script project has been discontinued, and there will be no further updates or releases. The project will remain private.

ProBaconHub has been discontinued. There will not be any further updates, as I have left the Roblox community.
